# TiptoBook

> TiptoBook (operated by Alomonx Technology Pvt. Ltd.) is an online on-demand local services marketplace platform in India connecting customers with verified, trusted local service professionals.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **CCTV Security & Smart Locks**: Home and commercial HD CCTV camera installation, live remote monitoring, digital smart lock installation, and maintenance (starting ₹2,999).
- **Vehicle & Car Rentals**: Everyday AC cars (5-seater and 7-seater), outstation cabs, and luxury decorated wedding cars with professional chauffeurs (starting ₹2,499/day).
- **Wedding & Event Services**: Candid wedding photography, cinematic wedding films, drone shoots, floral stage decoration, catering counters, and bridal makeup (starting ₹15,000).
- **Home Salon & Beauty**: At-home haircuts, facials, cleanups, bridal and party makeup, manicure, pedicure, and waxing (starting ₹799).
- **House Help & Repairs**: Background-verified maids, full home deep cleaning, home cooks, babysitters, elder care attendants, AC repair, electricians, and plumbers (starting ₹199).
- **Home Tuition & Coaching**: Personalized 1-on-1 home tuition for school academics (Class 1-10), senior secondary (Class 11-12), competitive exam preparation (JEE/NEET), and spoken English (starting ₹2,500/month).

## Service Areas
- Patna, Bihar
- Delhi NCR
- Mumbai, Maharashtra
- Bengaluru, Karnataka
- And expanding across India
